setup.note: Reused round-1 install (node_modules, built dist/ page with exportToBlob, local Nunito fonts). Served dist/ with python http.server on port 4328; copied render.mjs pointing to 4328. Scene = Excalidraw element skeleton generated by node scripts (common.mjs, p1/p2/p3.mjs), converted with convertToExcalidrawElements and exported with exportToBlob in headless Chromium (playwright-core).

fixes: render1: step descriptions and loop-4 label wrapped leaving 1-2 orphan words -> explicit line breaks in descriptions/labels

design choice: decision step 4 drawn as a wide orange card centred ON the axis (badge on top edge) so the 4->3 loop can go left/up into step 3 without crossing the axis; steps 1-3 and 5-7 alternate sides
7->6 loop routed under step 7, along the bottom and up the left margin into step 6, label in the empty space under step 6
limits: Step 4 sits on the axis rather than on one side (deliberate, to make the decision stand out and keep the loop clean)
Some empty space on the right of steps 3 and left of step 5 (stagger side effect)

fixes: render1: ring arrows drawn as 60-point polylines got tiny/misplaced arrowheads (Excalidraw sizes the head from the last segment) -> fewer points + last segment forced >=34px

render1: loop labels overlapped cards/arcs; 'Đồng ý' arrow between steps 4 and 5 too short -> rotated ring so decision step 4 is at 6 o'clock and the start gap (7|1) at 12 o'clock with a 'Bắt đầu' marker; loops drawn as inner counter-clockwise arcs; phase labels moved to corners/bottom with dashed radial dividers
render2: orange loop label touched badge 3, start arrow too short -> moved label and start arrow
limits: Dashed style on the multi-point loop arcs renders nearly solid (dash pattern restarts on each short segment); loops are distinguished by colour + label instead
No arrow from 7 back to 1 (the process does not restart there); ring has a gap at 12 o'clock used as the 'Bắt đầu' marker
Phase arcs shown as dashed radial dividers + corner/bottom labels, not as labelled arc bands (no room inside 1080 for an outer band; Excalidraw has no text-on-path)

fixes: render1: cards small with empty bands above/below in each lane, 'Đồng ý' crowded between 4 and 5 -> taller cards (225px), larger fonts (27/20), wider gap 4->5
render2: step 2 description left a one-word last line -> reworded
limits: Top lane (Khách hàng) is empty in the Triển khai column because steps 6-7 are Kind Content's (~13% of frame)

notes: peak_ram_mb comes from measure.py (ru_maxrss of the largest child process, so it is the biggest single process — node or a Chromium process — not the sum of the browser's process tree)
No LLM/API used; scenes hand-written as code; PNG exported by Excalidraw's exportToBlob at exact canvas size with exportPadding 0 and a white canvas rectangle
